label: ALTER INDEX
type: the SQL++ statement that moves index replicas between nodes or changes replica count
note: Round 16 folded the filename spelling `n1ql:alterindex` in - the same defect as n1ql:createfunction, found four rounds later for a mechanical reason worth recording: this spelling was in the corpus the whole time and `recurrence.py --variants`, the check built to report exactly it, could not see it. It appears only in the object slot of a seeAlso, and until bug #11 was fixed that slot reached no counting table at all - not even the one labelled "any mention". Excluding a relation kind from a metric and excluding it from a census are different decisions.
